title: Tool call
description: The tool_call event: the model asked for one tool, with these arguments, and the adapter is about to hand the call to the host (callTool for a runtime tool, execute for a host tool). Emitted before the call is made, so the host can journal it; its arguments are the model's own, before the host's gate rewrites anything. A host tool with an interaction (ask_user, delegate_tasks) gets no tool_call: it gets user_question or delegation_requested instead. Read from the AssistantEvent union (web/src/assistant/engine.ts). Open: no reader at run time refuses another member.

callId.description: Pairs the call with its tool_result. The codex engine always sets it (the server's 48-hex call id); the vercel engine sets it on an interactive session, and always on its refusal of a repeated call or of a call made on the final, tool-free request; never on a call to a tool the model was not offered.

name.description: The tool's own name. The codex engine offers its tools on the agent wire under aliases (desk_runtime_N, desk_host_N) and reports the real name here.

args.description: The arguments exactly as the model wrote them. Usually an object; a call to a tool the model was not offered carries whatever the model sent, or {}.

presentation.description: Host-owned presentation frozen when the tool was offered. Added by a host consumer (the research run) from the offered host tool, never by an engine and never from model arguments.

mcpCall.description: The params of the tools/call frame the host's gate inspects before it leaves the page (web/src/assistant/toolGate.ts, inspectOutboundFrame). Open: the gate keeps other members of params. Its rules: the name must be on this session's allow-list, a subset of the Desk's ceiling (get_schema, list_examples, get_example, validate, experimental_evaluate), or the frame is refused and a guardrail refused event is emitted; arguments, where present, are an object; and experimental_evaluate always leaves with an own rehearsal: true, with a guardrail rewrote event where the model's call did not already carry it. The host keeps this rule; an adapter never applies or skips it.

agentWireCall.description: One tool-call frame's call on the agent wire, from the Desk server to the browser (codexbridge.ToolCall). The browser reader (web/src/assistant/agentTransport.ts) refuses an id that is not 48 lower-case hex digits, a repeated id, more than twenty calls in a run, a name it did not offer and arguments that are not an object; it does not refuse another member.

name.description: The alias the codex engine offered the tool under; the browser refuses any name it did not offer.
